supersedes.reason: v1 omitted fused q/k L2 normalization and the required query scale

objective: Validate and measure the model-correct AVX2 single-token recurrent Gated DeltaNet update at the exact Qwen3.8-27B shape, including raw q/k preprocessing and an actual 48-layer state stream

scope.operator: single-token recurrent Gated DeltaNet q/k preprocessing plus state update
scope.claim_boundary: isolated q/k preprocessing and recurrence only; excludes projections, causal convolution, post-recurrence RMSNorm/gating, output projection, attention, MLP, lexical operators, sampling, and end-to-end model execution

model_contract.state_equations: state *= exp(g); memory = k @ state; delta = (value - memory) * beta; state += outer(k, delta); output = q @ state

candidate.numeric_contract: scalar-order FP32 q/k norm sums and separate FP32 multiply/add in the same per-column row order as the scalar oracle; no FMA contraction
candidate.state_update: in place without materialized normalized q/k or repeated 16-to-48 q/k heads and without per-token state allocation
candidate.trusted_entry_contract: the enclosing graph guarantees finite raw q/k/value/decay/beta/state; the entry point still checks pointers and dimensions and the kernel still rejects non-finite output

control.parity_requirement: bit-exact FP32 output and final state at the exact one-layer model shape using the same model-correct raw q/k contract

measurement.one_layer_order: alternating scalar-avx2 and avx2-scalar pairs with state reset outside the timed interval
measurement.full_stack_state: 48 independent 3 MiB recurrent states, updated sequentially without reset between timed tokens
measurement.cache_interpretation: the full 144 MiB state stream is authoritative for recurrence-only tokens/s; one-layer latency is a kernel diagnostic only

promotion_rules: a pass promotes only the model-correct AVX2 q/k preprocessing plus recurrence implementation from reference to measured kernel
a pass does not establish full-layer parity because projections, convolution, post-recurrence normalization and gating, and output projection remain outside this benchmark
a pass does not establish end-to-end tokens per second, model capability, storage efficiency, or energy efficiency
CUTE plus MMLU-type or MATH-500 capability gates remain mandatory after graph integration
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
no scientific breakthrough claim can come from this isolated microkernel
